title: Bijective constant scalar extension reflects finite lisse cohomology
statement: Let C be a small site with topology T [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let f:B to D be a bijective homomorphism of commutative rings. Use the constant coefficient rings and derived scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension], derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and their cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. If the i-th cohomology sheaf of the derived scalar extension of an arbitrary object K over B has local constant finite D-module descriptions [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], then the i-th cohomology sheaf of K has local constant finite B-module descriptions. No boundedness, Noetherianity, or nilpotence is assumed.

proof.text: The inverse ring isomorphism induces inverse restriction-of-scalars functors on sheaves. Construct the cancellation isomorphisms sectionwise using the ordinary module restriction equivalence. For a ring-sheaf isomorphism, ordinary extension of scalars is naturally isomorphic to restriction along its inverse: use the uniqueness of left adjoints on sections, with the unit sending m to 1 tensor m, and then sheafify. Naturality follows on these tensor generators.

Use the universal left-derived functor in [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The exact inverse restriction equivalence induces a derived functor, and the uniqueness of left-derived functors identifies it with the chosen constant coefficient scalar extension. Exact functors commute with homology.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-lisse-restriction] to the bijective map, using its surjectivity, to restrict finite local models after the homology comparison. Then cancel the inverse coefficient equivalence to recover K.

theorem locallyConstantFiniteTypeModules_of_scalarExtension_bijective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] (T : GrothendieckTopology C)
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing D] (f : B →+* D)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T B))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T D))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T B)))
    (i : ℤ)
    (h : IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T D
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj
        ((constantCoefficientScalarExtension T f).obj K))) :
    IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T B
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj K)
